behaviors.description: Embed an independent signing key and observe retained origin verification after bundle installation.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed B source, public key, unsigned A source and runtime.
behaviors.expected: Both generated bundles install exact B. Only the embedded-key origin rejects a later unsigned A update; the keyless control accepts A.

mappings.rationale: A real update trust decision distinguishes embedded key data from bundle command acceptance or serialized metadata alone.

surface_assertions.rationale: The embedded independent key enables persistent signature verification and rejection of unsigned updates.
